tei:div.tei:p: 388) ngag tu/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ zhes grangs 'bum phrag tsam ma song bar du bsags/ de ltar dpyad dpyad nas rnam rtog thang chad de 'gro mi btub pa na mnyam par gzhag yang rnam rtog ldang ba'i tshe sngar ltar dpyad/ de ltar dpyad 'jog spel mas thun grol ma ran bar du bsgom/ thun grol dus de ltar bsgoms pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des mtshon dus gsum bsags dang bsag par 'gyur ba'i zag bcas zag pa med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed mchis pa blos gcig tu bsdoms nas ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral ste mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i phyir du sngon gyi bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i rjes su bslabs te yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o snyam pa dge rtsa gong nas gong du spel ba mjug bsngo ba dam pa yin/ de nas sngar dam bcas pa de shor ram ma shor snyam du dpyad de ma shor bar dmigs pa legs par zin nas dga' 'ong tshe/ bsod nams 'khyams pos phyir bltas zer ba yin pas dga' don med snyam nas nga rgyal bcag dam bca' shor nas 'khrul pa'i dbang du song bas sdug 'ong tshe/ de sngon 'khrul par song yun ring bas ci khag thun phyi ma'i nang du de ltar mi byed 389) snyam du dam bcas te blo spro bsrings nas sems bar ma zhig skye 'ong bas de la lam gyi yon tan skye ba yin/ de nas dal gyis ldang nas thun mtshams 'gro 'chag sogs kyi dus kyang thun nang gi dmigs pa de mi brjed par skyong ba gal che/ slar thun la zhugs pa sogs thun gsum mam bzhi gang byed pa des rigs 'gre/ de ltar bsgoms pas bag chags kun gzhi la 'jags nas skad cig ma tsam yang brjed du med pa ma 'ong gi bar 'bad dgos/

'di sgom dus bde ba can gyi zhing khams bkod pa sogs 'od mdo/ 'chi med rnga sgra sogs dang*/ bde smon khrid yig le tshan sogs dpe bltas byas nas rgyas par blo la 'char thub dgos/ 'di kho nas kyang bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin no/ rgyu gnyis pa ni/ thun dang thun mtshams phye nas thun gyi sbyor dngos rnams gong dang 'dra ba las/ thun gyi dngos gzhi yan lag bdun gyi tshogs gsog pa'i dmigs pa ni/ tshogs zhing mgon po 'od dpag med dngos su bzhugs par bsam pa'i mdun du rang gi lus brgya stong mang po dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi lus bye ba mang pos phyag 'tshal bar bsam zhing*/ ngag tu sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ bde ba can du skye bar byin gyi rlobs/ zhes brjod cing phyag 'bum ther kha skong bcas bsag chu mchod/ 390) me tog spos/ mar me/ zhal zas sogs ci 'byor bshams nas de dag las brgya stong khri 'bum mang po 'phros/ de re re la'ang grangs med pa mang po spros pa'i kun bzang mchod sprin yid la byed pa dang*/ sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi zhing gi 'byor pa blos blangs te mgon po 'od dpag med la sems can thams cad bde ba can du skye ba'i phyir 'bul snyam pas chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis gsungs pa'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog i daṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍa la kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ zhes 'bum ther ma song bar bsag rang gzhan gyi tshe rabs nas bsags pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba la dug drag po khong du song ba lta bu'i 'gyod pa dang*/ phyin chad nyes pa 'di dang 'di mi byed snyam pa'i dam bca' dang*/ bshags pa'i yul mgon po 'od dpag med sras dang bcas pa la sdig pa dag par khyed mkhyen snyam pas skyabs su gsol ba dang*/

sku las bdud rtsi rgyun babs pa rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ bdud rtsi rgyun gyis lus gang bas nad thams cad rnag khrag gdon thams cad srog chags/ sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam par dbang po'i sgo ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir song bas sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu 391)'chi bdag gshin rje glang dmar po'i gdong pa can sogs lan chags bu lon gyi bdag po rnams kyi khar song bas lan chags bu lon sod/ sha mkhon byang*/ de dag gi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems skye bar bsam la/ aṃ pad+ma sa twa sa ma ya= sogs nas/ pad+ma ma me muñca pad+ma'i bha ba ma hā sa ma ya sa twa aḥ zhes 'bum phrag bar du bsag yan lag lhag ma bzhi ni 'khor 'das kyi dge ba la dga' zhing phrag dog med pas rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ sku mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ dge rtsa gzhan don du bsngo ba rnams kyang dpyad 'jog spel mas bsgom/ rgyu gsum pa ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa la dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom/ bdag gzhan rje ba/ bde sdug rje ba/ ngar 'dzin rje ba/ gces 'dzin rje ba rnams dang*/ rang 'dod yid byed kyi 'gong po gzhan phan byang chub sems kyis yul phud rjes 'don bya/ dbugs tshur rngub dus sems can kyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal thams cad sprin nag po'i rnam par rang gi sna bug nas zhugs/ mgrin pa'i gnas nas ser sprin 'khrigs/ 'brug sgra drag tu ldir bas rang gi phung khams kyi ngar 392)'dzin thams cad gcig tu 'dus te lte 'og na 'ug rgan zhig gi rnam par gnas pa la ser ba drag po 'bab/ thog zhig lhung nas mgo la rgyab ste lhag med du byas par bsam/ rlung phyir gtong dus rang gi bsod nams bde skyid dge rtsa thams cad sprin dkar po'i rnam pas sems can thams cad kyi steng du char sprin 'khrigs nas zas gos nor longs spyod kyi char babs pas ngoms shing tshim/

bsam pa bzang po byang chub kyi sems bcos ma min pa skye bar bsam mo/ de ltar goms pas pha bsad pa'i shan pa lag dmar dang 'phrad kyang bsam bzang lam lam ma byung gi bar du 'bad do/ rgyu bzhi pa ni/ spyir bsngo ba la 'khor gsum dmigs med kyi bsngo ba dang*/ de dang rjes mthun pa gnyis yod/ dang po ni/ dbu ma'i lugs ltar na 'di ltar snang bzhin pa'i chos bden bden grub grub tu 'dzin pa 'di rnams rang sa rdul phran rdul phran cha med/ cha med rang bzhin med par dpyad nas dpyad ngor dpyad bzod du grub pa'i rdul phran phra mo tsam ma rnyed pa'i stong nyid yod med yin min sogs spros pa'i gra zur gang yang med pa'i spros bral chen po yin pa'i nges shes yang yang bskyed nas/ de lta bu'i stong nyid spros bral de don dam pa'i dpyad ngor yin yang*/ tha snyad tsam du stong nyid kyi gdangs bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi rnam par shar ba 393)sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu/ snang bas stong pa ma spang*/ stong pa snang ba ma spang*/ snang ba stong thog tu spyan ma drangs/ stong pa snang thog tu spyan ma drangs/ snang bzhin du stong*/ stong bzhin du snang*/ snang stong dbye bsal med pa'i rang bzhin khong du chud pas bsngo ba dang rjes mthun pa ni/ sngon gyi bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i rjes su slob nas/ de dag gis sems can gzhan don dge rtsa ji 'dra byas nas bsngo dar na ngas kyang de dang 'dra bar bsngo bsam pa de yin/ gang bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsa rang gi bsod nams bsags pa ci yod pa bsdu gzhir byas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i zag med kyi dge rtsa rnams mar bsdu/ sems can thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i zag bcas kyi dge rtsa yar bsdu/ thams cad gcig tu bsdoms te bsngo dgos/ gang gi tshad du bsngo na ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad srid pa 'khor ba'i mtha' dang zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' gnyis las 'das pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i phyir dang*/

de ma thob kyi bar du dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can du skyes nas zhing khams kyi dpal la longs spyod/ sangs rgyas 'od snang mtha' yas rdul bral shin tu rnam par dag pa'i mtshan dpe'i 394)zhal ras mjal/ tshangs pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bcud la rol/ thugs kyi dgongs pa lhag ma med pa la longs spyad de nyon mongs pa dang shes sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa byang nas sa lam gyi yon tan thams cad rim gyis rdzogs/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang la mthar gyis dkri ba'i phyir bsngo ba ste/ de rnams dpyad 'jog spel mar sgom zhing*/ bzang spyod smon lam dang bde smon rgyas bsdus rnams 'bum phrag tsam ma grub bar du 'bad/ dus rgyun du tshogs drug gi snang ba gang dang ci shar thams cad kyang gzugs snang thams cad 'od dpag med kyi sku/ sgra grags thams cad gsung*/ dran rtog thams cad thugs ye shes chen po'i rol par lta zhing lam du khyer/ nam 'chi ba'i dus la babs pa'i tshe na yo byad thams cad spong dag byed/ tshe 'di'i zhen pa yid yul 'char du mi 'jug sdig pa la bshags sdom/ dge ba la bsngo smon/ chos skyong gi gtor ma gshegs la phrin las gsol/ 'pho lung gi gdams zab la brten nas dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can du 'gro snyam pa'i dga' brod dang bcas pas 'pho'o/ dam chos nyams su blang na 'tshengs lags kyang*// nyams su len bshad rgyang gdugs ltar phub// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i chos dred rigs can rnams// dam chos nyams su len par byin gyis rlobs// bde ba can dang pad+ma 'od la sogs/ 395) /sprul pa'i zhing du 'brel bcas phyin nas kyang*// sa lam yon tan mig 'phrul lta bus rdzogs*// rgyal ba mchog gi go 'phang thob gyur cig ces pa'ang smyug 'dzin khyu mchog phun tshogs pas bskul ba dang*/ bu blo gros kyis bri gzhi sbyar bas 'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros des bla ma'i man ngag rnams gang dran shar mar bris pa dge legs 'phel//
